notes.title: Update report 2018-08-14
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am very sorry to have kept you waiting.

Today we updated the new version

Added higher resolution and full screen mode to the game

And re-created a new interface for each language version. Let the text be presented in a more beautiful way.

The following is the update of this version:
-------------------------------------------------- --------------

* Improve game resolution

* Increase full screen mode

* Redraw the traditional Chinese game interface

* Redraw the Simplified Chinese game interface

* Redraw English English game interface

*Repaint Japanese Japanese game interface

-------------------------------------------------- --------------

Any new version of the problem can report it to us

We will fix it as soon as possible

We expect the next revision, which will add a new dialogue system to the game.

Strengthen the interaction between the store and customers and staff. Stay tuned.

Thank you

notes.title: Development Report - 2018-03-17
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I am a game developer.

We have already started the development of the next updated version
Development time is one month and it is expected to be completed in mid-April.

Report development content:
------------------------------------------

* Game screen adjusted to 800*600.
* Add full screen switch function.
* Repaint the language interface.
* Fix the bug.
* Add customer interaction dialogue

------------------------------------------

When development is completed will be updated immediately give you the players.
Thank you again for your support.

Zhao Yi

-------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------
Happy Home - Founded in 1999
Independent development - 
4 online games,
11 models PC/Mobile/Platform Stand-alone games.
Give you the most abundant game content.

notes.title: The game version is ready
notes.content:
First, thank you for your attention

We have just completed the preparation of the shelves version

And upload is complete waiting for the issue date


During this time we will continue to test

notes.title: Development Report 2017-12-12
notes.content:
Thank you all for coming here

Multilingualization of the game is currently being revised,


Confirm the language included in the sale when there is

Traditional, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese



In addition

Spain and French and German are expected



Due to the language processing process
Making the estimated time to market delayed

Apologize to everyone here

Hope that by a Chinese inn unique Chinese style

Bring global Chinese players a full Chinese flavor.

Thank you


ChaoYe
